newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord Entertainment names Terry London COO.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord Entertainment names Terry London COO.

text.p: Terry E. London, chief financial officer of Gaylord Entertainment Co, has been named executive vice president and chief operating officer of the entertainment company, said Gaylord president and chief executive officer E.W. Wendell.

London, 47, who has been chief financial officer since the company became public in 1991 and was promoted to senior vice president and chief financial and administrative officer in 1993, will begin his COO duties effective Monday. He will immediately begin a search for a new chief financial officer.
